lines.text: GTA 6 drops November nineteenth Here are five things you need to know before you hit play.
Number one. It unlocks at midnight your local time. There's no single global launch So players in New York get in a full three hours before L A West Coast, you're waiting

Number two. The download is huge Rockstar says up to two hundred and twelve gigabytes depending on your console. Pre-loading has been open since November tenth so start it tonight Not at eleven fifty-nine
Number three. Buying physical? There's no disc in the box. It's just a download code So you still need the space, and you still need the internet. And the Ultimate Edition? That's digital only

Number four. The bonus isn't only for pre-orders. Buy before November twentieth and you get the Vintage Vice City Pack A classic fifty-five Stanier, a garage, outfits, hairstyles and a weapon pattern. Yes, launch day counts
And number five. There's still no PC version announced. But if you're on Xbox One you're not totally out. Rockstar says you can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming
So, are you playing at midnight or waiting Let me know.
